fees.source: Robinhood activity exports (Trading Jan 1 - Oct 19 2026; Agentic Jul 7 - Oct 19 2026) plus Robinhood order history for Oct 21-22 2026 fills (Oct 22: $0.21 equity sale fee + $1.08 option open-fill regulatory fees). fees.note: Fees are booked in their own field per row (fees / regulatoryFees), never netted into realizedGain.

reconciliation.method: Cross-checked vs independent FIFO round-trip analysis of the Robinhood exports (Muse, 2026-10-19): Trading $45,584.97 net-of-fees over 550 round trips. This ledger books gross-of-fee close events; after the Sep backfill mis-tag repair (HD 300C), pre-window exclusions, and SPCX-close-20, the Trading total reconciles within fee treatment (~$14) and per-row rounding.
